preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A ready-made policy: keys_never (every credential kind must ask before sending), client_names (client and matter details must ask), clinic (patient and staff identifiers must ask), or tax_office (Social Security, tax ID, bank and birth-date details and client names must ask). Your other settings are added on top; an explicit requiredResponses entry beats the preset's.

orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown to your people in Clotr and on the printed policy page. Up to 80 characters.

requiredResponses.title: Required responses
requiredResponses.description: Kinds of data (as in patterns.js, e.g. aws_access_key) and how Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. A floor, never a ceiling: a person may still choose a stricter response than this for themselves.

watchWords.title: Watch words
watchWords.description: Words or phrases (up to 4 words each) to warn about, e.g. project code names. A format with # for a digit and @ for a letter (at least 4 marks, no digits, for example EMP-#####) is watched as a format instead. Together with the words and formats in kinds: 500 words and 50 formats in all. Words are turned into one-way fingerprints on each computer; formats travel as typed (they aren't secret).

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: People can see but not change Clotr's settings or vault.

kinds.title: Your own kinds
kinds.description: Up to 20 kinds of detail your organization names itself, for example a matter number or a client name. Clotr warns about each one by its name and, with Bandage on, swaps it for its cover word, like [Matter 1]. Words and formats are shared with watchWords: 500 words and 50 formats in all. Nothing about them leaves the computer.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in warnings, up to 40 characters, e.g. Matter number.

words.title: Words
words.description: Words or phrases of this kind (up to 4 words each), e.g. client names. Turned into one-way fingerprints on each computer.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: Formats of this kind: # for a digit, @ for a letter, at least 4 marks, no digits, up to 40 characters, e.g. MAT-######.

near.title: Nearby words
near.description: Optional, up to 10: a format counts only when one of these words is within 40 characters before it, e.g. matter or file.

response.title: Response
response.description: How Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. A floor, never a ceiling. Warn if not set.

cover.title: Cover word
cover.description: Bandage's word for it, up to 20 characters, no digits or brackets: Matter gives [Matter 1]. The name if not set.
